Modified for Democena (2026), an independent Demotale fork. The local package is not published to npm; build the checkout first.

# democena

> Product demos that don't go stale. Write the walkthrough once. Ship a video, a gif, or pictures
> for the docs. CI films it again when the UI changes. Playwright walks the clicks, text on screen
> explains each step. Fully local, no account, no upload.

democena is an npm CLI (`democena`). A scenario is a Playwright test in `demo/*.demo.ts`.
 Agents should run `npx democena agent-guide` after install and follow that page — not invent steps
 from memory.

## When to use

- Demo / screencast / walkthrough / README gif of a web UI on localhost
- Keep the demo in git so CI can re-record when the UI changes

## When not to use

- Native desktop/mobile apps, voiceover narration, hosted recording SaaS

## Install

```bash
npm i -D /absolute/path/to/democena
npx democena init
```

Requires Node >= 22.12. Chromium comes with the package. Put ffmpeg on PATH, or
`npm i -D ffmpeg-static`. If Chromium is missing: `npx democena setup`. Diagnose with
`npx democena doctor` (installs nothing itself).

## Agent loop

1. `npx democena doctor --json`
2. Point `democena.config.ts` at the real app
3. Write `demo/<thing>.demo.ts`
4. `npx democena check --json` — open the PNG frames
5. `npx democena video` (mp4), `gif`, or `images N` — ask for the artefact you need
   `npx democena record` is what CI runs: one play, whatever the config lists
